ModMetaData.name: Batshit Technology
ModMetaData.author: Matt "Breakpoint" Heck
ModMetaData.description:
The Future: Sooner. Cheaper. Funnier. And ludicrously dangerous.
Ridiculous, misguided and insanely overpowered gadgets, in their own research tab (Batshittium Lore, Batshittium Arcana).
Batshittium: an element transmogrified from ordinary rock chunks, ten to one, in the Batshittium Transmogrifier.
Batshittium Reactor: 250,000 W from one unit of batshittium for anywhere between 0.1 and 36 hours, with enough waste heat to cook every room within 12 tiles. Build it far from home. Its self-destruct flings three full Ballista volleys in every direction.
Random Replicator: fabricates a random food item every 6 in-game hours into a refrigerated compartment (10 items) that haulers empty into your stockpiles. It draws 50W, plus 50W while refrigeration is on. Pawn-armed self-destruct: a 10-second countdown, then a massive blast, fires racing out behind the shockwave and seconds of secondary explosions.
Brain Squeezer: a chair colonists sit in for moderate recreation, muttering disturbing inner monologue. They come away calmer, with fewer breakdowns, riots and arguments for a day.
Batshit Ballista: volleys of up to 256 insanely inaccurate, terrifyingly destructive bolts, up to 325 tiles away, every five seconds. Painful (kinetic) and Really Painful (explosive) bolts come from an automated Artificer and feed in from chained magazines. Range and projectile count multiply its power draw, up to four reactors at full fire.
Ergonomic Singularity Grenade: thrown, it drags everything within 10 tiles into a pile for five seconds, ripping furniture and walls loose, then explodes. Survivors find it remarkably comfortable.
Everything blows up: damage can set off a self-destruct, and every other device pulverizes itself in its own way when destroyed.
Showcases: a Showcases button at the bottom of the main menu stages all of the above in a fresh, throwaway colony that never autosaves. Requires Harmony, for that button.
